limitations.note: The rewrite fixed the counter’s idle-cycle advance but also made `ready_a` high during reset and changed `valid_b` to pulse only on the sixth accepted bit, rather than preserving the registered ready signal and count-based valid timing.
The test required `ready_a` to be high during reset and expected `valid_b` only on the sixth accepted bit, so it passed by treating both timing changes as correct.
